'''Mint''' is a deprecated server-based [[web analytics]] tool. It tracks [[Web traffic|traffic]] trends, [[HTTP referrer]]s, and [[Web search engine|search]] trends.<ref>{{cite news|author=Aaron Wall |url=http://www.internetfinancialnews.com/financialblogtalk/news/ifn-6-20070823MintKeepYourAnalyticsWebsiteTraffic.html |title=Mint: Keep Your Analytics / Website Traffic... |publisher=Internetfinancialnews.com |date=2007-08-23 |accessdate=2010-01-30}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|last=Sostre|first=Pedro|author2=Jennifer LeClaire|title=Web Analytics for Dummies|location=Hoboken, NJ|publisher=Wiley Pub.|year=2007|pages=98 to 99|isbn=978-0-470-09824-0|oclc=77540819}}</ref>

The developer Shaun Inman discontinued sales and support on December 24, 2016.<ref>{{cite web|author=Shaun Inman |title=Goodbye Mint, Goodbye Fever|url=http://shauninman.com/archive/2016/12/24/goodbye_mint_goodbye_fever|website=Shaun Inman // Compendium|date=2014-12-24|accessdate=2 January 2017}}</ref>
